visit.title: Visit
visit.intro: For people coming for the first time.
visit.expectBody: Sunday worship is at 10:00 AM in the main sanctuary.
visit.parkingBody: We are at 15 Alpha Road, Chelmsford, MA 01824. Park there and come in through the main door.
visit.kidsBody: Children's worship meets during the Sunday service. Times and rooms are on the Generations page.
visit.kidsPhotoAlt: Children and teachers at a classroom table
visit.contactBody: Ask someone after worship, or send a message on Facebook.

about.title: About
about.intro: Boston Milal Korean Church is a Presbyterian church in Chelmsford, Massachusetts. Milal means a grain of wheat.
about.motto: Serve one another as good stewards (1 Peter 4:10)
about.pastorBio: He studied theology at Chongshin University, then M.Div. and Th.M. at Gordon-Conwell. He previously served as pastor of Lebanon Korean Presbyterian Church.
about.identity: We worship in Korean in Greater Boston.
about.congregationAlt: Church members gathered outdoors in front of the building

koreanSchool.title: Korean School
koreanSchool.intro: Sunday classes in Korean language and culture for children.
koreanSchool.goals: Kids learn Korean, and they get used to being at church.
koreanSchool.time: Sundays, 9:30-10:30 AM, in the spring and fall.
koreanSchool.contact: Classes meet at 15 Alpha Road, Chelmsford, MA 01824. Ask after worship if you have questions.
